items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: I was into Hendrix and Robin Trower and all those kind of players out of that Hendrix school.

ctx.x: Did you — I read you had aspirations or you were — I don’t want to overstate this, perhaps you wanted to be the guitar goddess of heavy metal?

Yeah, well yeah. When I was a teenager I — well I grew up in a family of professional — actually church organists really. And so we had to study piano and I’m telling you my — wherever she would be in the universe — if my piano teacher knew that I was a professional musician and educator she’d probably just, I don’t know, she’d be in shock. Because I was not a great piano student. But — maybe because everybody played at a really high level in my family and I don’t know, I was also a little younger, I was…

Did you have a period where you were playing some fairly technical music in that genre but you had yet to find out — I hesitate to say this because it sounds like an insult almost, but you didn’t know what you were doing from a musical standpoint from a chordal standpoint, music theory?
